el.Cantante y compositora. Escribo cancione: Singer-songwriter. I write songs from what I've lived and what has changed me.
el.Soy cantante y compositora, letrista de: I'm a singer and songwriter, a lyricist of my own emotions. Writing has always been how I express what I feel: first I have to live things, then understand them, and only then do they become songs.
el.ADN habla de mis raíces y de mi identida: ADN is about my roots and my identity, about everything that makes me who I am. Rompecabezas is one of my truths, and the others are on their way. I carry my grandfather with me everywhere.
el.Reconstruirme no es volver a ser quien e: Rebuilding yourself doesn't mean going back to who you were, but recognizing yourself in everything that has changed.
